summary: Remote agent exposes WebSocket-driven PTY, filesystem, and self-upgrade control of the installer host
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent runs as a long-lived agent on the installer host that dials a configurable WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via the SERVER_URL environment variable or persisted config) and executes commands received over that socket. The message router dispatches inbound frames to handlers that spawn interactive shells via node-pty and forward attacker-supplied bytes to the terminal (terminal_create / terminal_input → pty.write), read, write, move, and delete arbitrary files on the host, run git operations, and trigger self-upgrade via `npm install`. Authentication is a shared `agentSecret` provisioned by the operator, so any party that knows the secret or controls the configured server URL obtains full remote code execution and file access on the host running the agent. service/linux.js also mutates PATH by prepending ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin to the environment used by spawned processes.
